post.description: Creates an API Key for the authenticated subject. Only a website Access Token can create API Keys. The complete API Key is returned only in this response.

201.description: A newly created API Key, including its one-time complete value.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents storage of the one-time complete API Key.

apiKey.description: Complete API Key. This value is returned only once.

expiresAtUtc.description: Expiration time in UTC, when configured.

delete.description: Revokes an API Key owned by the authenticated subject. Only a website Access Token can revoke API Keys.

204.description: The API Key is revoked or was already revoked.
